smallest_successful_continuation: Route the Rung 005 semantic drill through the actual conversation/cognition surface or build a specific training intake path that requires MIM to publish an interpretation object artifact before any approve/complete status is allowed.

Completion must require artifact fields, not generic next-step approval.
